title: Series and Parallel Circuits
description: Interactive simulation comparing series and parallel circuit configurations. Shows how current and voltage distribute differently in each type.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: electricity
circuits
physics
learningObjectives: Calculate equivalent resistance for a series circuit using R = R₁ + R₂ + R₃ and for a parallel circuit using 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + 1/R₃
Compare how current stays constant while voltage divides in series, versus voltage staying constant while current divides in parallel
Predict which bulb glows brightest in each configuration by relating branch power to the resistor values
Explain why removing one resistor stops a series circuit entirely but leaves the remaining parallel branches operating
Analyze why a parallel combination's total resistance is always less than its smallest individual resistance
